integrity: The exact formulas and limits are supported by an analytic proof. An included exact-rational and numerical quadrature script reproduces finite checks; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: First unrestricted depth-one acceleration only; independent Gaussian oracle noise; fixed sigma>0 and lambda down to zero; no statements on safeguarded iterates or long-run behavior.
title: Exact Gaussian heavy tails and sharp weak-regularization risk for depth-one Anderson acceleration
